entries.section_heading: Better seed systems begin with better questions.
entries.text: Sage Harvest Agro Pvt. Limited is an independent, practitioner-led advisory firm focused on seed supply chain strategy, transformation and practical decision support. WHY WE EXIST

entries.section_heading: Bridging field realities with management decisions.
entries.text: Seed businesses operate across biological uncertainty, seasonal cycles, quality constraints, infrastructure decisions, working capital and market commitments. A good strategy must connect these pieces rather than optimize them in isolation. Our approach combines operating experience with analytics, digital tools and sustainability thinking to help leadership teams see the system clearly and act on the highest-value constraints. OUR PURPOSE & DIRECTION

entries.section_heading: Stronger seed systems. Better decisions. Lasting value.

entries.section_heading: Cotton Hybrid Quality Risk: Using Lot-Level Data to Find the Signal
entries.text: An anonymised example of how seed-quality data can move a discussion from anecdotal concern to evidence-based risk assessment. Challenge Determine whether quality failures are disproportionately concentrated in one production or genetic segment of a cotton hybrid portfolio compared with a relevant comparator. Approach Compare lot-level outcomes and apply appropriate statistical tests—including a Chi-square test and a two-proportion comparison—to assess whether the observed difference is likely to be meaningful rather than random variation. Management implication Lot-level evidence can help management focus root-cause investigation, sampling and corrective action where risk is concentrated rather than treating all lots as equally exposed. GREENFIELD PROJECTS

From seed to supply chain to strategy — bringing nearly four decades of experience across the seed and agri-business ecosystem to the next chapter of industry transformation. Practitioner-led. Independent. Seed-industry focused. THE PRACTITIONER BEHIND SAGE HARVEST

Raja Vadlamani is a senior seed and supply-chain professional whose career has spanned nearly four decades across the seed and agri-business industry. His experience covers supply-chain leadership, seed production, processing, quality, warehousing, inventory, transformation and strategic initiatives. His professional journey includes experience with Corteva, Advanta, Shriram Bioseed and SeedWorks International , giving Sage Harvest a perspective shaped by different organizations, operating models and stages of industry evolution. At Sage Harvest, this experience is translated into independent advisory work—helping organizations strengthen supply chains, use data and AI more effectively, build climate resilience, evaluate transactions and pursue international opportunities. This notice explains how Sage Harvest Agro Pvt. Limited handles personal information in connection with this website and its visitor-facing services. Last updated: 6 October 2026
Sage Harvest Agro Pvt. Limited (“Sage Harvest”, “we”, “us” or “our”) operates this website and provides independent advisory services in seed and agri-business supply chains.

We may receive information that you choose to provide when you contact us, such as your name, email address, organisation, role and the information contained in your enquiry. When you use Puja, our AI-assisted voice guide, the service may process the text or audio you submit, together with technical information needed to establish and operate the voice session. The current website does not contain a conventional contact form or an installed analytics script.

Information may be used to respond to enquiries, discuss potential engagements, provide and operate Puja, maintain website functionality, protect the website and services, and comply with applicable legal obligations.

Puja uses a Sage Harvest-controlled Cloudflare Worker to obtain a short-lived access token and then connects to Google's Gemini Live service for the AI-assisted voice interaction. The website does not expose a Gemini API key in its client-side code. Because Puja relies on third-party infrastructure, information transmitted through the service may also be subject to the relevant provider terms and privacy practices. Sage Harvest does not represent that third-party processing is governed solely by this policy.

The website is published using Cloudflare Pages, with source code maintained in a GitHub repository. Cloudflare may process technical information, including IP addresses and request data, to deliver, secure and operate the website under its own privacy and security practices. GitHub may process information associated with repository access and development services under its own policies.

The current Sage Harvest website does not intentionally deploy its own analytics or advertising cookies. Third-party services linked from the website, including YouTube, LinkedIn or other external destinations, operate under their own privacy practices when you visit or interact with those services.

We do not sell personal information. Information may be shared with service providers where reasonably necessary to operate the website or an engagement, where you have requested or authorised the disclosure, or where disclosure is required or permitted by law.

We seek to retain personal information only for as long as reasonably necessary for the purpose for which it was collected, for legitimate business needs, or as required by applicable law. Specific retention periods may depend on the nature of an enquiry or engagement.

If you have a question about personal information held by Sage Harvest, or wish to request access, correction, deletion or other action available under applicable law, please contact us at raja.vadlamani@gmail.com . We may need to verify your identity before acting on a request.

Sage Harvest intends to handle personal information in accordance with applicable data-protection requirements and evolving regulatory obligations, including India's Digital Personal Data Protection framework as applicable to the organisation and the relevant processing activity. This notice is not a representation that every provision of that framework is currently in force or applicable to every visitor.
We may update this notice when our website, services or legal obligations change. The latest version will be published on this page with its update date.
For privacy questions or requests, contact Raja Vadlamani , Sage Harvest Agro Pvt. Limited.
Sage Harvest recognises that advisory work can involve commercially sensitive information, strategic decisions and operating data. Last updated: 6 October 2026

Information shared with Sage Harvest in connection with a potential or confirmed engagement is handled with appropriate discretion and care. Information is used for the purpose for which it has been provided or as otherwise agreed. Access is limited, where reasonably practicable, to people or service providers who need the information for the relevant purpose. Confidential information is not intentionally disclosed to third parties except where authorised, required by law, or necessary for agreed professional or service-provider purposes. Appropriate safeguards are used for documents and information under our control. Confidentiality expectations may continue after completion of an engagement, subject to applicable law and the terms agreed with the client.

An initial enquiry through the Sage Harvest website or by email does not, by itself, establish a formal client relationship or a comprehensive confidentiality obligation. Please do not send commercially sensitive, confidential or restricted information in an initial enquiry. A brief description of the challenge is normally sufficient for an initial conversation.

Where an assignment involves material confidential information, Sage Harvest may recommend an appropriate confidentiality agreement or include confidentiality provisions in the engagement documentation. The confidentiality obligations applicable to a particular assignment will be governed by the relevant engagement letter, NDA or other written terms agreed with the client.
